skill_name: Describe a situation in which two people might disagree but still work together to solve a problem.
workflow: In some situations, two people may have different goals or approaches to solving a problem, yet they can still work together effectively despite the disagreement. One example would be two engineers collaborating on a complex project. The two engineers may disagree on how to approach the project and how to use certain resources but they can still work together to find a mutually beneficial solution. They can recognize and respect each other's point of view and use it to inform each other's action
